name: Jensen Huang
quote: AI is not likely to replace you, but someone using AI better than you might.

name: Bill Gates
quote: AI will change the way people work, learn, travel, get health care, and communicate with each other. Entire industries will reorient around it. Businesses will distinguish themselves by how well they use it.

name: Sam Altman
quote: AI will not replace humans, but humans using AI will do jobs that previously took a lot of people. A single person will be able to do what used to take a 10-person company.

name: Marc Andreessen
quote: AI doesn't want, it doesn't have goals, it doesn't want to kill you, because it's not alive. And AI is a machine — is not going to come alive any more than your toaster will.

name: Sundar Pichai
quote: The future of AI is not about replacing humans, it's about augmenting human capabilities.

name: Satya Nadella
quote: The whole design choice we've made is to put humans at the center, which is why we call it Copilot, not Autopilot.

name: Demis Hassabis
quote: AI is going to be 10 times bigger than the Industrial Revolution, and maybe 10 times faster.

name: Thomas Kurian
quote: AI is not going to replace people. People who use AI will replace people who don't. The goal is to make people dramatically more productive and let them do what humans do best: create, communicate, and solve problems.

name: Andrew Ng
role: Founder, DeepLearning.AI & Managing General Partner, AI Fund
quote: AI is the new electricity. Just as electricity transformed almost everything 100 years ago, today I actually have a hard time thinking of an industry that I do not think AI will transform in the next several years.

name: Ginni Rometty
quote: Some people call this artificial intelligence, but the reality is this technology will enhance us. So instead of artificial intelligence, I think we'll augment our intelligence.

name: Arvind Krishna
quote: If you can produce 30 percent more code with the same number of people, are you going to get more code written or less? It's a tool. If the quality that everybody produces becomes better using these tools, then even for the consumer, now you're consuming better-quality products.

name: Mustafa Suleyman
quote: Over the next decade, AI will augment human capability on an unprecedented scale. It's not about replacing humanity; it's about amplifying what makes us capable.

name: Garry Kasparov
role: Former World Chess Champion & AI Thought Leader
quote: AI won't replace humans, but those who use AI will replace those who don't. Weak human plus machine plus better process was superior to a strong computer alone.

name: Karim R. Lakhani
role: Professor & Co-Founder of Laboratory for Innovation Science, Harvard Business School
quote: AI won't replace humans — but humans with AI will replace humans without AI.

name: Richard Baldwin
role: Professor of International Economics, Geneva Graduate Institute & IMD
quote: AI won't take your job. It's somebody using AI that will take your job.

name: Dr. Fei-Fei Li
role: Co-Director, Stanford HAI & Co-Founder, World Labs
quote: It really, truly bothers me when people use the word 'replace' when it's connected to AI. I think we should really replace that word, and think about AI as augmenting or enhancing humans rather than replacing them.

name: Yann LeCun
role: Chief AI Scientist, Meta & Turing Award Laureate
quote: Our intelligence is what makes us human, and AI is an extension of that quality.

name: Geoffrey Hinton
role: Nobel Laureate & Turing Award Laureate ('Godfather of AI')
quote: In a sensibly organized society, if you improve productivity, there is room for everybody to benefit. The problem isn't the technology, but the way the benefits are shared out.

name: Dario Amodei
quote: I think of AI as a tool that dramatically accelerates intellectual work, allowing small teams or individuals to do science, engineering, and creative work at a scale never seen before.

name: Andrej Karpathy
role: Founding Member, OpenAI & Former Director of AI, Tesla
quote: The hottest new programming language is English.

name: Jensen Huang
quote: It is our job to create computing technology such that nobody has to program, and that the programming language is human. Everybody in the world is now a programmer. This is the miracle of AI.

name: Satya Nadella
quote: Natural language is the new UI and programming language... Software development is shifting from writing syntax to expressing intent.

name: Amjad Masad
quote: English is replacing code syntax. In the near future, programming will look much more like speaking to and directing a smart colleague than writing intricate syntax.

name: Peter Norvig
role: Director of Research, Google & Co-Author of 'AI: A Modern Approach'
quote: For sixty years, we wrote rigid code that instructed machines deterministically. Now, natural language prompt engineering has become the primary mechanism to steer emergent intelligence.
